site.name: Marton Paulo
site.title: Marton Paulo, software developer
site.description: Marton Paulo, full-stack developer from Brazil: web products with React, Next.js and TypeScript, and native macOS apps in Swift. Selected work, bio and contact.

person.name: Marton Paulo
person.availability: Open to remote work and relocation
bio: I'm a full-stack developer who never stopped caring most about the front end. I've spent the last several years building web products with React, Next.js and TypeScript, with Java and Spring Boot on the other side of the API, and lately I've been shipping native macOS apps in Swift.

I like the part of the work where a screen stops being a spec and starts feeling right: the spacing, the empty states nobody asked for, the refactor that makes the next feature cheap. Most of what I build on my own is small, local-first and free.
I'm from Brazil and open to remote work or relocation. I speak English, Portuguese, Spanish and Esperanto, and I'm learning Mandarin.
now: Building small native macOS utilities in Swift: a window switcher, a Gmail notifier and a world clock, all living in the menu bar.
Making browser tools that keep your data on your machine, like a table editor and an SVG atlas.
Studying Mandarin Chinese, slowly and stubbornly.
interests: Hitchhiking across two continents and finding places most people never hear about. I sometimes work while travelling, and every now and then I go on a ten-day hike for fun.

Learning languages. Besides the ones I speak, I've picked up bits of French, Russian, Arabic, Brazilian Sign Language (Libras) and Toki Pona. Talking to people in their own language is the whole point.
Tinkering with my tools: a VS Code setup tuned past reason, an old Linux machine kept alive because I can, and a growing pile of scripts for macOS.

projects.name: WindowHop
projects.tagline: Switch between windows, not just apps, on macOS.
projects.description: A native macOS window switcher with large app icons or live previews, bound to a keyboard shortcut. Free, GPL-licensed, no telemetry. Built because Command-Tab switches apps and I wanted to switch windows.

projects.name: Mailbell
projects.tagline: Gmail notifications in the macOS menu bar, with no server in between.
projects.description: Instant IMAP IDLE alerts for Gmail, a review queue you can clear in one click, and OAuth with PKCE stored in the Keychain. The app talks to Gmail directly; nothing of yours passes through anyone else's machine.

projects.name: Meantime
projects.tagline: World clocks in the macOS menu bar, with time travel.
projects.description: Scheduled clocks, a quick calendar, and a slider that moves every clock at once so you can find a meeting time across time zones without arithmetic. Native, fast and private.

projects.name: Tabelo
projects.tagline: Edit one table visually or as text, entirely in your browser.
projects.description: A table editor where the grid and the text formats stay in sync: Markdown, CSV, TSV, JSON, HTML and Jira. Everything runs locally as a PWA, so no table you paste ever leaves your machine.

projects.name: Atlas Tint
projects.tagline: An interactive SVG atlas for colouring and tracking regions of the world.
projects.description: Select countries and regions, give them colours, and keep the result locally. Built on D3 and TopoJSON with keyboard navigation for every region, because a map you can only use with a mouse is only half a map.

projects.name: Issues Graph
projects.tagline: See the blocking order of a GitHub backlog as a graph.
projects.description: Reads issue dependencies through the GitHub API and lays them out as a directed graph in the browser, with nothing installed in the repository being read. Useful for finding what to unblock first.

projects.name: Todo Print Editor
projects.tagline: Design and print to-do lists as exact-size A4 layouts.
projects.description: A visual or Markdown editor for structured checklists that prints exactly as laid out, offline, with the layout stored on your machine. For people who still like paper.

projects.name: Country Badge Generator
projects.tagline: Downloadable SVG, PNG and JPG country badges from flag colours.
projects.description: Pick a country, get a badge with one of three deterministic, flag-inspired backgrounds, and download it in the format you need. Plain JavaScript, no build step, tested end to end with Playwright.

projects.name: Small Lights
projects.tagline: Forty points of light drift, bond, age and speak in a dark field.
projects.description: An ambient agent-based simulation on a canvas: the lights move, form bonds, grow old and occasionally say something through the Web Speech API. No build, no dependencies, one HTML file.

projects.name: GitHub Blog
projects.tagline: A blog whose posts are GitHub issues.
projects.description: Shows a GitHub profile and its posts, where each post is an issue in a repository: the title is the issue title and the body is the post. Markdown rendering, search, and nothing to host.

projects.name: Budget Control
projects.tagline: A simple tracker for income and expenses.
projects.description: Log transactions, watch the balance, and search what you spent. A study project on forms, context and derived state in React.

projects.name: Coffee Delivery
projects.tagline: An online coffee shop with a cart and checkout flow.
projects.description: Browse a curated coffee menu, customise an order, and check out. A study project on shopping-cart state, forms with validation and styled-components.

projects.name: Catalogue of Languages
projects.tagline: Every documented language in the Wikitongues database, in one table.
projects.description: An interactive table for exploring the world's linguistic diversity, fed by the Wikitongues Airtable base. A side project born from a hobby.

projects.name: Pomodoro Timer
projects.tagline: A focus timer with a history of what you worked on.
projects.description: Start a cycle, name the task, and keep a log of finished and interrupted sessions. A study project on React context, forms with Zod and styled-components.

projects.name: React To-Do List
projects.tagline: Add, complete and delete tasks, in TypeScript.
projects.description: A small to-do list built to practise componentisation, props, state and immutability in React with TypeScript.

projects.name: Community Feed
projects.tagline: A social feed with comments and applause.
projects.description: Simulates a social media feed with commenting, applauding and deleting comments. Built with Vite to practise hooks, state and immutability, with Jest tests.

projects.name: KeyForge
projects.tagline: Generate and evaluate passwords in Node.js.
projects.description: A library for generating cryptographically secure passwords with customisable options, plus a function that scores the strength of an existing one. Published on npm.

projects.name: Angular To-Do List
projects.tagline: A to-do app with an Express back end.
projects.description: Add, edit, complete and delete tasks, with Angular Material for the UI and a small Node and Express API behind it. Built to practise components, services, routing and forms in Angular.

projects.name: Angular Calendar
projects.tagline: A calendar built from scratch with Angular Material and CDK.
projects.description: Month view, events, and drag interactions written by hand on top of Angular's component kit, without a calendar library.

projects.name: Svelte Calculator
projects.tagline: The iPhone calculator, rebuilt in Svelte.
projects.description: Same layout, same behaviour, a different framework. A weekend of Svelte to see what the fuss was about.

projects.name: Bézier Curves
projects.tagline: Draw Bézier curves with the mouse.
projects.description: An interactive canvas for placing control points and watching the curve follow, built for a computer graphics course at CIn-UFPE with p5.js.

projects.name: Survive
projects.tagline: An audio game about staying alive after the end of the world.
projects.description: Played entirely by ear: a narrator describes the situation and the player chooses. No graphics, so it works for people who cannot see the screen, which was the point.

projects.name: Proffy
projects.tagline: Connecting teachers and students, on the web and on the phone.
projects.description: A web and mobile app for finding a teacher and booking a class, built during Rocketseat's Next Level Week for Brazil's Day of Education Professionals.

projects.name: Investments Dashboard
projects.tagline: The stock market's biggest moves, at a glance.
projects.description: A plain dashboard for tracking the largest market fluctuations, key indices and favourite assets, made for people who want a quick daily look rather than a trading terminal.

projects.name: Simple JavaScript Games
projects.tagline: Bouncing balls, Take the Color, and other small games.
projects.description: A collection of tiny browser games written while learning JavaScript, jQuery and p5.js. Where a lot of this started.

projects.name: Course exercises
projects.tagline: Clones, to-do lists and API demos from front-end courses.
projects.description: Exercises from Digital House, Digital Innovation One and PUC Minas: a Twitter login clone, a Netflix home page, a CEP search, a Snake game, a movie search, an iFood clone in React Native, and more. Kept for the record.
